translation_unavailable: Translation unavailable. Showing the English canonical version.
create_intro: Readers can become contributors. Translate a story, propose a connection, add a new story, or fork the universe.
world_seed_intro: Your answers form a World Seed. This version stores the seed in your browser; future branches may use it to change routes and worlds.
world_seed_empty: Your World Seed is empty. Experience Thresholds will add choices here.
reset_world_seed_confirm: Clear all World Seed choices stored in this browser?
github_production_space: GitHub is the production space of the universe. Commits preserve contribution history; branches preserve possibilities; forks may become independent universes.
translation_adaptation_note: Translations remain the same story ID. Cultural reinterpretations become new story nodes connected to the universe.
